as_of_note: Compiled 2026-11-11 by the Qatar source-audit lane (iteration 19). CONTEXT ONLY: never a scoring input. Every value was read from the cited page or dataset in this session; vintages are mixed (2023-2025) and stated per row, and must not be combined into one 'current' picture. No value is later than a 2025 annual total, and none describes the state of any facility. Bases differ by source: country totals from EIA; operator totals from QatarEnergy's and KAHRAMAA's datasets on the Qatar Open Data Portal (CC BY 4.0). Capacities are nameplate or contracted figures and say nothing about operation. National aggregates only: no facility, train, plant or route figure is recorded. See docs/countries/QA_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

metrics.basis: country total; 67.5% natural gas, 32.5% crude oil and other petroleum liquids; coal marked not applicable
metrics.source: U.S. EIA, Country Analysis Brief: Qatar, Table 1 (last updated 2025-10-20)

metrics.basis: country total, crude oil and other petroleum liquids (includes condensate and natural gas liquids), so NOT comparable with crude_oil_production
metrics.source: U.S. EIA, Country Analysis Brief: Qatar (last updated 2025-10-20)

metrics.basis: operator's annual figure for 'Crude Oil Production'; crude only, as labelled; rounded from 595.12
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Production of Crude Oil, Natural Gas and Refinery Throughput', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: operator's annual figure for 'Gross Natural Gas Production'; GROSS, not dry or marketed gas, and 'gross' is not defined in the dataset; rounded from 20.995
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Production of Crude Oil, Natural Gas and Refinery Throughput', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: operator's 'Total annual LNG quantity exported'; national annual total; rounded from 79.329. The same series gives 77.8 (2020), 78.0 (2021), 78.8 (2022), 78.8 (2023) and 78.7 (2024)
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Exports of LNG, Gas, Naphta and Crude Oil', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: national total NAMEPLATE LNG export capacity at end-2024 per EIA; nameplate, not an operating rate
metrics.source: U.S. EIA, Country Analysis Brief: Qatar (last updated 2025-10-20)

metrics.basis: country total, pipeline and LNG together; EIA preliminary estimate (about 3.6 Tcf as LNG, nearly 0.8 Tcf by pipeline)
metrics.source: U.S. EIA, Country Analysis Brief: Qatar (last updated 2025-10-20)

metrics.basis: operator's annual daily average of gas exported by pipeline; national total, no route or destination recorded
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Exports of LNG, Gas, Naphta and Crude Oil', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: operator's annual figure for crude oil exports, onshore and offshore fields together; crude only
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Exports of LNG, Gas, Naphta and Crude Oil', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: national total capacity to process crude oil and condensate (EIA Table 4 total); nameplate; a secondary compilation. Gas-to-liquids capacity is a separate total and is not included. Per-facility figures are deliberately not reproduced
metrics.source: U.S. EIA, Country Analysis Brief: Qatar, Table 4 (last updated 2025-10-20)

metrics.basis: operator's annual figure for 'Refinery Throughput'; national total; whether condensate is included is not stated; rounded from 386.16
metrics.source: QatarEnergy, 'Qatar Energy Production of Crude Oil, Natural Gas and Refinery Throughput', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-08-18)

metrics.basis: national electricity generated, utility's annual series (58,493 GWh in 2024). EIA's figure for 2023 is 56 TWh net, virtually all from natural gas
metrics.source: KAHRAMAA, 'Annual Electricity Generation', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-09-29)

metrics.basis: maximum system load of the year (recorded in late August); the dataset stops at 2024
metrics.source: KAHRAMAA, 'Maximum and Minimum System Load (MW)', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-10-27)

metrics.basis: national count of electricity customers by number of meters
metrics.source: KAHRAMAA, 'Number of Electricity Customers and Annual Growth Rate', Qatar Open Data Portal (modified 2026-10-28)

significance: Natural gas made up 67.5% of Qatar's primary energy production in 2023 and crude oil and other petroleum liquids 32.5%; EIA marks coal as not applicable.
Qatar exported an estimated 4.4 Tcf of natural gas in 2024, about 3.6 Tcf of it as LNG (EIA, preliminary).
QatarEnergy reports LNG exports of between 77.8 and 79.3 million tonnes in each year from 2020 to 2025.
In 2023 Qatar generated 56 TWh of net electricity, virtually all from natural gas (EIA).
